title: Crush Signal Studio
oneLiner: A playful flirting rehearsal lab where users turn vague attraction, unread messages, and overthinking into bold scenario cards, chemistry scores, and shareable confidence boosts.
targetUser: Young adults who like someone, hate mixed signals, and want a fun low-stakes space to rehearse flirt energy before making a move.
keyUX: Drop in a crush situation, remix possible moves, and get a dramatic confidence board that turns hesitation into playful momentum.
stitchPrompt: Design a bold desktop flirting rehearsal lab called Crush Signal Studio for young adults dealing with attraction, unread messages, and mixed signals. It should let users turn a real crush situation into scenario cards, playful move options, chemistry scores, and a confidence boost they can actually act on. Include a crush vibe intake card, a mixed-signal decoder board, a move suggestion carousel, a chemistry confidence meter, a risk-versus-reward scene builder, and a victory recap drawer. Design direction: use a playful-experimental aesthetic with glossy nightlife accents, confident contrast, flirt-forward motion cues, and one unmistakably theatrical main flow so the product feels cheeky, stylish, and instantly memorable.
